title: pi.decisions.request.v1
description: Backend -> sidecar request for the Jev Decisions adapter, per docs/PI/pi_jev_implementierungsplan_de.md section 3.3. This is an APPLICATION contract; decisionsService.ts translates it into whatever the verified provider wire format turns out to be (M0/M3) and never forwards it byte-for-byte.

state_projection.description: Allowlist projection of pi.decision-state.v1: no secrets, absolute paths, full FITS headers, or unnecessary free text (pi_jev_decisions_plan_de.md section 9). The exact projected field set is frozen in M0.

allowed_candidates.description: candidate_id values the provider may choose among; always includes keep_current and insufficient_evidence (pi_jev_decisions_plan_de.md section 3).

candidate_descriptions.description: Optional. candidate_id -> what the change candidate does (catalog provider_description, 1..240 printable ASCII characters, no path/URL/key). Only for change candidates; baselines are described by the question set.

candidate_facts.description: Optional. candidate_id -> evidence the backend already resolved for it, as plain scalars (numbers, booleans, short tokens). Never names, paths or free text. The sidecar puts it into state.candidate_facts.
